overnight.summary: Thursday was a record-close, cool-inflation session: July PPI printed FLAT 0.0% m/m vs +0.2% expected (y/y 4.7% from 5.5%; energy -3.1%, gasoline -5.7%; core y/y 4.2%), June revised to -0.1% — two days after in-line CPI and one week after a -23k payrolls miss, Fed-hike pricing deflated (Polymarket 2026-hike ~56% on 8/12; funds rate 3.50-3.75%) [^1^][^2^][^3^]. S&P 500 +0.65% to a record 7,798.99, Nasdaq +0.81% to 26,803.03, Dow +0.13%, Russell 2000 +0.24% to 3,052.85 after a record intraday print; VIX 14.63, 10Y 4.64% (-0.9%), DXY 99.95 [^4^][^5^]. The tape rotated back to software: IGV +3.1% with WDAY +18-21% on a Silver Lake LBO report, while SNDK +15% paced the S&P after its Investor Day laid out FY28-30 mid-to-high-teens growth at ~80% gross margin — memory supercycle confirmation [^6^][^12^]. TSLA +3.8% led Mag7 on a Nevada application for up to 5,000 robotaxis [^14^]; AMZN was the only Mag7 in the red [^6^]. After the close AMAT delivered the beat-raise the book wanted — rev $9.12B +25%, EPS $3.50 vs $3.40 est, Q4 guide $10.25B/$4.02 vs $9.56B/$3.69 est, and the FCF tell resolved: $2.33B vs $210M last quarter — yet shares slipped ~3% AH, the Cisco sell-the-news template again [^8^][^9^][^10^][^13^]. Oil fell a second day (WTI -2.4% $81.25, Brent -2.1% $87.10) as the Hormuz premium bleeds; gold -1.3% to $4,410 knocked GDX -2.96% into the book's 86-89 armed lane [^6^]. Asia Thursday was led by Kospi +3.56% and Nikkei +1.16% on the AI-hardware bid, Hang Seng/Shanghai slightly red [^7^]; Friday's Asian session opens after this report's generation with AMAT -3% AH as the handoff.
overnight.implication: Cool PPI + record close keeps a bid under US tech into Friday's retail sales — but AMAT's beat-raise-and-dip (-3% AH) is the second sell-the-news template in two days: extended AI/semi names get bought at zones, never chased at opens; if SMH loses 585 pre-market the 555-570 zone activates, and GDX at 88.27 is now inside the armed 86-89 lane.
